title: Calibration protected reference solution and review guide
answer: A strong submission for Calibration should complete this objective: Compare predicted probabilities with observed outcomes. It should demonstrate the expected outcome (Evaluate probability reliability.), use a consistent and reproducible setup, report evidence rather than speculation, and address the limitation: Separate probability quality from class-label accuracy.
explanation: Review the result for technical correctness and reproducibility. The automatic check only looks for CalibratedClassifierCV, calibration_curve, brier_score_loss and does not run the learner code. Separate probability quality from class-label accuracy.
